result.detail: Docs list two auth methods for integrations: OAuth 2.0 and personal API token each user generates in own account settings. No registration, verification, or approval gate before other customers connect. No install/user/server cap stated. The only review text is for publishing a listed integration (contact integrations@apify.com for review/validation), which reads as optional listing, not a connect gate. Caveat: the page links no OAuth app-registration docs, and only this one page was fetched (via subagent).
result.quote: Use OAuth 2.0 to allow users to authorize your integration without sharing their credentials.
